description: This file implements the hardware abstraction layer (HAL) for the Flash memory on STM32F4xx microcontrollers, providing functions for programming, erasing, locking, unlocking, error handling, and interrupt management of internal Flash memory.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program
methods.description: Programs byte, halfword, word, or double word at a specified address, selecting the programming mode.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Program_IT
methods.description: Programs byte, halfword, word, or double word at a specified address with interrupt enabled.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the Flash control register for write/erase operations.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_Lock
methods.description: Locks the Flash control register to prevent accidental modifications.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the Option Bytes control registers.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Lock
methods.description: Locks the Option Bytes control registers.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_OB_Launch
methods.description: Launches the option byte loading process.

methods.name: HAL_FLASH_GetError
methods.description: Returns the current Flash error code.
